narr: A narrow stripe of heavy rain lifted northward across central Adams County the morning of May 15, 2025, producing localized flash flooding issues.
ev: Localized heavy rain led to a bridge being washed out near the intersection of York Road and Centennial Road in Straban Township.
Heavy rain led to the intersection of Swift Run and New Chester roads in Straban Township becoming flooded and impassable.
